ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
The complete surviving French/Russian letter, separate four-part Russian editorial rendering, both page markers, and all five footnotes are represented.
misérable, vilain is kept as wretch, bad man; the editorial Russian презренный, дурной is separately rendered contemptible, bad, without harmonizing the two witnesses.
запишусь чего нибудь is conservatively I will enroll in something, preserving Tolstoy's vague plan rather than supplying an institution or service.
The editors' statement that the beginning of the letter has not survived is retained in the publication note; no beginning is reconstructed.
